comment: Rdc2 is a flavin-dependent halogenase involved in the biosynthesis of the fungal metabolite radicicol.

reactions.description: Rdc2 catalyzes the regioselective chlorination of a late-stage intermediate (monocillin II to pochonin D) during radicicol biosynthesis
Rdc2 can also halogenate hydroxyisoquinoline to produce chlorinated hydroxyisoquinolines
